scientific_integrity: An explicit proof is provided for a unit regular-octahedron Haar-planar-projection joint radius/vertex-count distribution and its conditional consequences. The unconditional normal-coordinate statistics, regular six-vertex probability, and vertex-count criterion are acknowledged as pre-existing; numerical tests are corroboration rather than a continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: Unit regular octahedron only; excludes triaxial octahedra, biased normals, and higher-dimensional shadows. Historical priority of an equivalent joint law needs independent scrutiny.
title: Silhouette-conditioned circumradius laws for random regular-octahedron shadows
